verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Auto Drafts feature explicitly writes replies in the user's own voice/tone (matching style from sent emails, even per-recipient), pulling context from inbox/calendar/web, and presents them ready to edit and send rather than generic boilerplate — with explicit human approval before sending. This is well-documented across first-party docs with consistent detail; missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration of draft quality/voice-matching accuracy beyond vendor claims.
